abilities.name: Silent Sisterhood
abilities.legend: The Null Maidens of the Silent Sisterhood bring with them the nightmare pall of their collective null aura, afflicting their opponents with a creeping sense of dread.
abilities.description:
• When mustering your army, you can select a friendly Anathema Psykana Character model to be your WARLORD.
• Friendly Prosecutor SQUAD units have BATTLELINE.
• Friendly Anathema Psykana units have the following ability:
Creeping Dread (Aura): In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit/below starting strength makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

abilities.name: Assemblage of Might
abilities.legend: The Emperor’s Custodians will gladly test their mettle against the worst the galaxy has to offer.
abilities.description: In your Command phase, you can select one enemy unit to be a dreadful foe unit until the start of your next Command phase. Friendly Adeptus Custodes Character models’ attacks that target a dreadful foe unit have +1 to wound rolls.

abilities.name: On Gilded Wings
abilities.legend: Terminator sodalities are swept up by golden drop craft, ready to be deployed once more as battle demands.
abilities.description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit is unengaged, you can place that unit in strategic reserves.

abilities.name: Moritoi Ancients
abilities.legend: The auramite giants of the Moritoi are terrifying to behold, moving with the grace of mortal warriors. Wounds serve only to increase the ferocity with which they slaughter their foes.
abilities.description:
• While a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit is at starting strength, that unit has +2 OC.
• While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below starting strength, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below half-strength, that unit’s attacks can:
• Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Wardens of the Dark Cells
abilities.legend: Inured to the most nightmarish and esoteric threats, the Shadowkeepers will not be swayed from their duty.
abilities.description:
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, melee attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Kaptaris
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

abilities.name: Martial Mastery
abilities.legend: The Custodians are masters of all forms of war. There is no foe, no matter how numerous or powerful, that they cannot lay low.
abilities.description:
In the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight, that unit’s melee attacks have:
• [Sustained Hits 1].
• Or: [Lethal Hits].

abilities.name: Companion’s Watch
abilities.legend: Among the Companions and the Sentinel Guard, vigilance is the most crucial of attributes.
abilities.description: While a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Talon Sortie
abilities.legend: The Solar Watch utilise speed, mobility and the adaptable Calistus Ka’tah to confound and eviscerate opposing armies.
abilities.description:
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to charge.

Favoured ka’tah: Calistus
Additional Effect: Your unit has +2" M.

abilities.name: Magna Imperator
abilities.legend: The Adeptus Custodes are blessed with gifts the Emperor has given them – physical might, mental robustness and the most powerful arms and armour available.
abilities.description:
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to attack, that unit’s attacks can:
• Re-roll one hit roll.
• Re-roll one wound roll.

Favoured ka’tah: Rendax
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with your unit and roll one D6:
• On a 1-2, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
• On a 3-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
• On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Heralds of the Throne
abilities.legend: The Emissaries Imperatus prioritise the mission over individual actions. Their favoured ka’tah, Conservai, similarly emphasises strategy.
abilities.description:
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units have Fights First.

Favoured Ka’tah: Conservai
Additional Effect: Until the end of the turn, being selected to make an advance/fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

abilities.name: Gilded Guardians
abilities.legend: Resilient experts of ranged warfare, the Aquilan Shield give no ground and punish advancing enemies with their mastery of the Salvus Ka’tah.
abilities.description:
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, ranged attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Salvus
Additional Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.

abilities.name: Flare Shields
abilities.legend: Many Adeptus Custodes vehicles are fitted with flare shields: relics of the Dark Age of Technology that can deflect incoming fire.
abilities.description: Friendly grav-assault units have 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

abilities.name: Instruments of the Emperor’s Wrath
abilities.legend: Favouring the aggressive Dacatarai fighting style, the Custodians of the Dread Host seek to outmatch their enemies in bloody melee combat.
abilities.description:
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units can re-roll charge rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Dacatarai
Additional Effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a pile-in/consolidation move, -2" from that pile-in/consolidation move.

datasheets.name: Venerable Contemptor Dreadnought
datasheets.legend: These towering combat walkers are piloted by centuries-old fallen heroes kept alive by irreplaceable technologies. Equipped with weapons that can melt armour and tear apart infantry, Venerable Contemptor Dreadnoughts inflict terrible damage, all while protected by atomantic shields and auto-repair protocols.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Combi-bolter; 1 Contemptor Fist; 1 Multi-melta.

abilities.name: Damaged 4
abilities.description: This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model’s remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged: while damaged, that model’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise D3
abilities.description: This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

abilities.name: Aegis of the Emperor
abilities.description: Friendly Adeptus Custodes units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Martial Ka’tah
abilities.description:
At the start of your Command phase, friendly Adeptus Custodes units with this ability are readied. While a friendly unit is readied, you can select one of the ka’tah abilities presented below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer readied.

Each ka’tah ability will tell you when that ka’tah ability can be used, and the effects that ka’tah ability has on the unit using it.

We recommend placing a token next to each readied unit, removing it when that unit is no longer readied.

Favoured Ka’tah
All detachments tagged ‘Unique: Shield Host’ state a Favoured Ka’tah. If you selected one of these detachments, the ka’tah ability that is the Favoured Ka’tah of that detachment grants the additional effect listed in that detachment.

Example: If you selected the Solar Watch detachment, when you select the Calistus ka’tah ability for a readied unit, that unit has +2" M in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.

CONSERVAI

KA’TAH ABILITY

WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly readied unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn:
• Being engaged/battle-shocked does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
• Starting an action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

CALISTUS

KA’TAH ABILITY

WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That readied unit.

EFFECT: When your unit makes a normal/advance/fall-back move, your unit can move through all types of model.

SALVUS

KA’TAH ABILITY

WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That readied unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
• BS.
• Hit rolls and wound rolls.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:

stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: Character/Monster].

stratagems.name: AT SPEAR'S LENGTH
stratagems.legend: Duty to the Golden Throne overrides all else. When called to strike a new target, Custodian sodalities withdraw from the fight in close order, keeping their spears leveled towards their foes and holding them at bay with close-range volleys of bolter fire.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.effectText: That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: GRAVIMETRIC GRENADE
stratagems.legend: Carried by many Custodians, these explosive devices detonate on impact, creating a field of gravitic energy that immobilises those caught in the blast radius.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.targetText: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes unit.
stratagems.effectText: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE
stratagems.legend: No obstacle, physical or otherwise, can halt the advance of the Solar Watch, nor stay their wrath.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
• M.
• Advance rolls and charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Arae-Shrike
enhancements.legend: Built into this Custodian’s armour, this aviform artefact is a relic of the Dark Age of Technology. It projects electromagnetic distortion to corrupt and confound homing beacons, teleportation technology and other methods of translocation.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. Enemy units that are selected to make an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

enhancements.name: Anti-gravitic Mobility
enhancements.legend: The grav-tanks of the Adeptus Custodes are exceptionally mobile, enabling their skilled crews to fade in and out of contact with the foe whilst keeping up a constant stream of killing fire.
enhancements.description: grav-assault unit only. When this unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

enhancements.name: Flawless Bladework
enhancements.legend: This Custodian’s skills in close-quarters combat are awe-inspiring to behold.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Lightning Descent
enhancements.legend: This Shield-Captain knows well the value of intelligence, utilising data harvested by agents of the Golden Throne to strike like a bolt of golden lightning before the foe can bring their strength to bear.
enhancements.description: Shield-Captain in Allarus Terminator Armour model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.legend: Knights-Centura of the Chamber of Oblivion demonstrate exceptional prowess with whichever weapons they opt to wield. Woe betide any witch who crosses their path.
enhancements.description:
Anathema Psykana model only. This unit’s attacks have:
• +1 to hit rolls.
• Or: If this unit targets a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit, +1 to hit rolls and wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Memento Moritoi (one per army)
enhancements.legend: This reliquary contains drops of blood, promethium and amniotic fluid harvested from the fractured form of a fallen Dreadnought. Said to be infused with the remaining fury of fallen warrior and war machine, this device inspires wrathful fury in those who bear it to war.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 A, S and D.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.legend: The armouries of the Adeptus Custodes contain some of the most finely crafted and deadly close-quarters weaponry wielded by any warrior of the Imperium.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Devastating Wounds].

enhancements.name: Not a Shell Wasted
enhancements.legend: Every volley these warriors fire is calculated to inflict the maximum amount of damage upon the foe.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +1 A.

enhancements.name: Edge of the Blade
enhancements.legend: This auric champion always strives to be first into the fray.
enhancements.description:
Adeptus Custodes model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model’s attacks can:
• Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Shroud of the Hidden Blade
enhancements.legend: Long-forgotten technologies shroud this cloak’s bearer.
enhancements.description:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has:
• Stealth
• Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Bane of Abominations
enhancements.legend: This Captain-Commander has earned many names destroying mighty champions and powerful war machines.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s attacks that target an enemy CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Unstoppable Destroyer
enhancements.legend: This Custodian unleashes upon their opponents the Emperor’s own fury, pursuing enemy warriors with relentless determination and allowing none to flee the field.
enhancements.description:
Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. When this unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move:
• This unit can move up to 4".
• You can select any consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

enhancements.name: Sally Forth
enhancements.legend: This warlord excels in directing fast and deadly offensives designed to close rapidly with the enemy, overwhelming the foe with a devastating concentration of force.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Shield-Captain model only. At the start of your Charge phase, select one friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit within 6" of this model. If that unit made an advance move this turn, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Combat Deployment
enhancements.legend: Custodian vehicle crews are as consummately skilled as their infantry counterparts, delivering sodalities into the thick of the fight and suppressing foes with turret-mounted weapons to prevent incoming fire.
enhancements.description:
grav-assault Transport model only. When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a disembark move from this unit, until the end of the turn:
• That unit can re-roll charge rolls.
• Enemy units cannot target that unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink (one per army)
enhancements.legend: The war engines of the Adeptus Custodes possess an array of augury equipment that combines to build an intricate picture of the unfolding conflict, enabling the bearer to detect incoming threats, then angle their armour to repel the worst of enemy attacks.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Huntress' Eye
enhancements.legend: This ancient bionic focuses the bearer’s null aura into a horrifying stare that can terrify foes to death.
enhancements.description: Anathema Psykana model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

enhancements.name: Pareldor's Caducatrix
enhancements.legend: This immeasurably ancient auto-medicae device meshes seamlessly with any suit of armour, dispensing panacaeic elixirs in response to mental or physical trauma.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the start of any phase, this model heals D3+3 wounds.

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.legend: The golden glory of the Emperor Himself glows around this magnificent warrior like Sol’s own fire. Enemies are blinded by its light, forced to recoil in pain and terror.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Auric Exemplar
enhancements.legend: This champion’s physical might is exceptional, even for a Custodian. Each swing of their blade carves a bloody swathe through the foe.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Cleave 1].

enhancements.name: Auriferous Orb
enhancements.legend: When this sphere of solid gold detonates, it unleashes beams of radiating light that blind those they do not kill.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has the following weapon:

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.legend: The cellular alchemy by which this heroic warrior was forged has rendered them breathtakingly resilient.
enhancements.description:
Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
• On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Genalchemic Warding
enhancements.legend: The genetic alchemy that saturates this warrior’s physiology has been tempered in wars beyond count. There are few hardships or hurts such a warrior cannot endure.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Emperor's Light
enhancements.legend: This masterwork misericordia is believed to flood the hearts of its victims with searing holy radiance.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has the following weapon:

enhancements.name: Leonine Ferocity
enhancements.legend: This Shield-Captain demands boundless aggression from the warriors at their command. Each movement by the foe is seized upon and punished with furious countercharges.
enhancements.description:
Shield-Captain in Allarus Terminator Armour model only. (Once per phase, per army) You can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
• That use is -1 CP.
• That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Auric Eagle
enhancements.legend: Embodying the raptors of ancient Terra, this champion of the Golden Throne descends upon their prey swiftly, with talons unsheathed.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry/Mounted unit only (excluding Terminator units). This unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Celeritous Sentries
enhancements.legend: Even while standing statue-still upon their endless watch, these Custodians are ready to spring instantly into violent action.
enhancements.description:
Trusted Sentinel unit only. (Once per phase, per unit) You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
• That use is -1 CP.
• That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Castellan's Mark
enhancements.legend: Awarded to the Custodian with the greatest tally of victories in the Blood Games, this finely worked pauldron denotes its bearer as a superlative strategic genius.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Custodes units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.legend: A master orator, this Custodian’s battle cries light fires of defiance in the hearts of their allies.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. (Once per battle round, per army) At the start of any phase, you can select one friendly battle-shocked Adeptus Custodes unit within 9" of this model. That unit is no longer battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Eagle's Eye
enhancements.legend: The sensorium gheists within this helm shriek technomantic warnings to the wearer whenever danger threatens.
enhancements.description:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only.
• This model has +1 W.
• (Once per battle, per army) When attacks are allocated to this model, you can use this ability. If you do, this model has 3+ InSv.
